method: Exploratory program outside production: when a final-lance player decision has at most two legal actions and every successor is terminal, integrate the exact policy-weighted utilities instead of drawing that final action. All attempted actions are undone. Other decisions retain ordinary sampling. Compare the same frozen policies, 32 evaluation seeds per run, 10000 hands per seed, three alternating pairs, CPU0. Time excludes checkpoint loading. Fewer draws change subsequent seeded trajectories; sample means are not expected to be identical. Evaluate estimated variance times time as a local efficiency measure; this is not a whole-table error bound or a production candidate.
runner_script:
import hashlib,json,os,statistics,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
root=Path.cwd();binary=root/'build/review-j10/release/mus-solver'
trial=Path('/tmp/mus-review-j10-terminal-trial')
output=Path('/tmp/mus-review-j10-terminal-trial.json')
data={'method':'Exploratory program outside production: when a final-lance player decision has at most two legal actions and every successor is terminal, integrate the exact policy-weighted utilities instead of drawing that final action. All attempted actions are undone. Other decisions retain ordinary sampling. Compare the same frozen policies, 32 evaluation seeds per run, 10000 hands per seed, three alternating pairs, CPU0. Time excludes checkpoint loading. Fewer draws change subsequent seeded trajectories; sample means are not expected to be identical. Evaluate estimated variance times time as a local efficiency measure; this is not a whole-table error bound or a production candidate.','runs':[],'summary':[],'source':Path('/tmp/mus-review-j10-terminal-trial.c').read_text(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(trial.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='terminal-trial-',dir=root/'build/review-j17-sync-io') as tmp:
    table=Path(tmp)/'scores'
    command=[str(binary),'--format','ordago-score','--score-region','35:35','--iterations','1000','--evaluation-samples','10000','--seed','7','--continuation',str(table)]
    subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
    data['training_command']=command
    for a,b in [(35,35),(39,39)]:
        group=f'{a}:{b}'
        for repeat in range(1,4):
            for mode in (['sample','integrate'] if repeat%2 else ['integrate','sample']):
                command=[str(trial),mode,str(table),str(a),str(b),'10000','32']
                line=subprocess.check_output(command,text=True).strip()
                values=dict(p.split('=',1) for p in line.split())
                row={'group':group,'mode':mode,'repeat':repeat,'command':command,**{k:float(v) for k,v in values.items() if k!='mode'}}
                data['runs'].append(row);output.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');print(group,repeat,line,flush=True)
        summary={'group':group}
        for field in ['seconds','mean_sample_variance','seed_mean_variance','integrated_hands']:
            before=statistics.median(r[field] for r in data['runs'] if r['group']==group and r['mode']=='sample')
            after=statistics.median(r[field] for r in data['runs'] if r['group']==group and r['mode']=='integrate')
            summary[field]={'sample':before,'integrate':after,'change_percent':100*(after/before-1) if before else None}
        summary['variance_time_change_percent']=100*(summary['seconds']['integrate']*summary['mean_sample_variance']['integrate']/(summary['seconds']['sample']*summary['mean_sample_variance']['sample'])-1)
        data['summary'].append(summary);output.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');print('SUMMARY',summary,flush=True)
decision: Keep ordinary sampling in production. This trial supports a local benefit at one policy, not a general improvement across a table. The experiment requested by J10 is recorded; no general integration mode is added.
interpretation: The per-hand variance reduction is resolved at 35:35. The short timing ranges overlap, so the small median time changes and variance*time products do not establish efficiency gains or regressions. Between-seed variance from 32 means is exploratory. No general integration mode is added.
